Short on time this week? Here’s the AI news worth knowing.

Anthropic filed to list its stock publicly on Nasdaq. Revenue for the first half of 2026: $16.3B, up from $1.2B a year earlier. Compute spending fell from about 6.5x revenue to about 0.5x.

AA Intelligence Index v5: 60% of the score now comes from private or held out tests. Opus 5.5 (max) 58, GPT-6 Astra 57, GPT-6.1 Sol 55. Sol costs about an eighth as much per task.

Effort matters: Opus 5.5 scores 35 at low effort and 58 at max, but at 10x the cost.

Unlimited OCR 2: 3.34B params, MIT license, hundreds of pages per request.

Give your team AI skills you can trust.

📰 Missed a few days of AI news? Here's what happened this week in Data Points, our twice-weekly newsletter. 👇

🔐 PHP2Shell: GPT-5.6 Sol helped find a memory bug in software running up to 70% of sites. Patch is out. Update now.
⚡ MiniMax M3.1 Flash: 428B total / ~23B active, 1M context, 0.15/0.60 per million tokens. Weights due Oct 23.
🔌 Meta's Muse Wonder: 4/20 per million tokens, OpenAI compatible endpoint. Trying it = new base URL + model name. No full safety report yet.
🐍 Python 3.15 is out, 3.10 is end of life. Lazy imports (PEP 810), unpacking in comprehensions (PEP 798), sampling profiler in the stdlib.
🏛️ GPT-6.1 Sol achieved 97.9% byte for byte output parity migrating COBOL at higher effort. GPT-5.6 Sol only scored 5.4% at low effort. Expert review still required.
